concerns.text: FR-001 and US-1 explicitly require generating 500 square-cropped control clips (125 per ratio equivalent) to serve as the baseline. Task T013 mentions generating control clips but lacks the specific count (500) and distribution logic required to satisfy the statistical power defined in SC-005 and the acceptance criteria in US-1. Without this explicit task detail, the implementation may produce an insufficient control set.

FR-005 and US-3 mandate a PAIRED statistical test (t-test or Wilcoxon signed-rank) because the experiment compares the same video content under two conditions. Task T027 describes selecting a test based on normality but fails to explicitly enforce the 'paired' constraint or reference the paired nature of the data. The plan.md also incorrectly suggests 'Independent Samples' tests, which contradicts the spec. T027 must be updated to explicitly implement a paired test to satisfy FR-005.

Task ID collision detected: T024 is assigned to 'Add logging for OOM events' in Phase 4 (US2) and 'Unit test for mIoU calculation logic' in Phase 5 (US3). This ambiguity prevents clear task tracking and execution. One of these tasks must be renumbered (e.g., to T029 or T036) to resolve the conflict.

The Plan.md Summary and Constitution Principle VI define the control group as 'Original Unmodified ActivityNet Captions' videos, whereas the Spec (FR-001, US-1) and SC-001 require a 'square-cropped (1:1)' control set generated to match the pipeline. T013 follows the spec's 'square-cropped' requirement but the plan's conflicting definition creates a risk of implementation drift. T013 should explicitly state that control clips are 'square-cropped (1:1) derived from source' to align with the spec and avoid the plan's error.
